acs.text: All files listed in SPEC.md's architecture exist (dirs + spec files).
`logs/events.jsonl` exists, and every line is valid JSON with `ts` and `event` keys.
At least one `UserPromptSubmit` event has been logged.
`.claude/settings.json` registers the UserPromptSubmit, Stop, PreCompact and SessionStart hooks.
`institutions.csv` has 35 or more rows, unique slugs, and a valid `type`.
Every slug has a `data/raw/<slug>.md` file with all 5 section headers.
Every section has a `url:` line that is either an http(s) URL or `not_found`/`blocked`.
Every section with a URL has at least one `>` quote block.
At least 70% of institutions have a URL for at least one of the dept_statement/university_guidance sections.
At least 50% of institutions have a URL for se_course.
Adi opens 5 random URLs and confirms that the quotes match. Log the result in PROGRESS.md.

Every source with a URL has a `source_date:` line: `undated`, or a year whose evidence shows that year (page evidence is verified verbatim by check_quotes; url evidence must be a substring of the URL).
`policies.json` validates against the schema (all required fields present, enums valid).
Every `evidence` string is an exact substring of the matching raw file (anti-hallucination test).
Every institution in the CSV has exactly one record.
The kappa function matches a hand-computed textbook example (unit test).
The counts in `findings.json` equal counts recomputed directly from `policies.json`.
The lexicon check runs, and its flags are listed for Adi's review.
The page loads with no console errors (headless Playwright test).
Every chart total equals the matching count in findings.json (Playwright reads the DOM/chart data).
The table row count equals the number of institutions. Search filters the rows correctly.
Works at 375px width with no horizontal scrolling.
Every AC in specs/phase-*.md has at least one test or a manual review entry (checked by a test that parses the specs).
tests.json matches the actual pytest run (same count, same statuses).
Filters work (Playwright test).
Includes at least one deliberately failing "canary" test, run once and shown in the history, to prove that the pipeline reports failures. Then remove it.
Every prompt in events.jsonl appears in timeline.json.
Timestamps are sorted, and each one parses as ISO-8601.
Every entry has a valid actor and phase.
Page loads with no console errors, and the filters work (Playwright).
Token totals in tokens.json equal an independent recomputation from the raw jsonl (test).
No duplicate message IDs are counted.
Every message has a phase and an activity.
Page loads with no console errors (Playwright).
The live URL returns 200 for all 5 pages (checked with curl).
Every relative link on the site resolves (link-checker test).
